data.body:
## Prioritized process-improvement program

P0 — Make escaped-defect measurement real. Extend bug intake/closure to require a bounded detection stage, first-seen ref or version, affected release/environment, and a confirmed or rejected introduction link; preserve unknown as an explicit value. Sample attribution accuracy instead of accepting blame-generated caused_by links. Indicators: at least 95% metadata completeness; escaped bugs per 100 merged source changes; stage distribution; time to detection; attribution false-positive rate. This is the prerequisite for knowing whether any quality intervention works.

P0 — Convert repeated plan-review churn into deterministic preflight. Pareto BLOCK criteria and encode stable structural checks locally before invoking an LLM; keep semantic review for architecture, failure modes, portability, testing strategy, and tradeoffs. Show actionable criterion-specific remediation. Targets: plan first-pass toward at least 70%, p90 attempts at most 4, and fewer LLM calls per unique claimable ticket while completion and defect indicators hold or improve. Do not optimize the review PASS rate alone.

P1 — Classify completion non-PASS reasons. Emit machine-readable categories for code defect, unmet acceptance criterion, missing test/evidence, environment/integration, and verifier/tool error. Move only recurring and deterministic checks into planning or local gates. Targets: completion first-pass toward at least 85%; verifier error rate separately visible; late code/AC failures per 100 tickets declining.

P1 — Apply risk-tiered review instead of universal ceremony. Build a prospective risk score from initial plan non-PASS, planned file breadth, security/store/concurrency surfaces, near-cap hotspots, and actual diff size. Require focused domain tests and non-author human review for the high-risk tier; keep low-risk documentation and mechanical work lightweight. Track defects/reverts by tier, queue age, and blocking-finding precision. Audit Gerrit reviewer/vote history separately before claiming the current human-review or bus-factor posture.

P2 — Manage debt before the hard cap. Add a soft 720-LOC warning and rank work only where near-cap size intersects churn, complexity, duplication, or defect history. Extract along existing call-graph seams, never by mechanical file splitting. Targets: modules at or above 720 LOC from 35 to fewer than 20; at or above 780 from 15 to fewer than 5; duplication from 4.09% to below 3%, with complexity and defects unchanged or better.

P2 — Preserve the process gains and broaden maintainership evidence. Keep full canonical ticket trailers, DCO, Change-Id, source/test co-change, governance documents, and tagged releases as baseline gates. Publish a lightweight contribution path and review-rotation ownership for critical domains, then measure unique active reviewers, reviewer concentration, response time, and external-contributor time-to-first-merge. Authorship concentration alone must not be used as the review metric.

Recommended sequencing: instrument defects and failure reasons first; use 4-6 weeks of clean data to calibrate risk tiers; simultaneously harvest deterministic plan checks; then fund debt reduction from hotspot evidence. Review this scorecard monthly, using control-style trends and cohort denominators rather than raw counts. No repository files were changed by this audit.
